title: How Iman Gadzhi builds a $10k/month online coaching business: UVZ, offer, acquisition
summary: Iman lays out a four-step path to $10k/month coaching: find a narrow unique value zone, build a high-ticket offer around problem, specific result and a named mechanism, acquire clients via outreach, referrals and organic content, then deliver with a structured call format. He stresses specialization as the source of pricing power and coaching as a way to learn your market.

principles.text: Go one layer deeper than niche: pick a unique value zone (e.g. weight loss for postpartum moms) so you can specialize and charge more.
principles.quote: having a uvz allows you to specialize and charge more

principles.text: Specialists command premium prices; generalists compete on price. Specialization creates perceived value.
principles.quote: Specialists command premium rates generalists compete on price clients pay more when they trust your expertise

principles.text: A coaching offer needs three parts: a core problem, a specific measurable result in a time frame, and a unique named solution.
principles.quote: there are three key parts to your coaching offer that you absolutely need to nail number one is the core problem

principles.text: Sell the outcome, not the coaching. Give your method a name; naming what you already do is enough to create a unique mechanism.
principles.quote: people do not buy coaching coaching is the vehicle in which to get them an outcome

principles.text: Don't run paid ads until you've hit $10k/month organically; you haven't validated the market or refined messaging yet.
principles.quote: stay away from Paid ads until you've surpassed at least $10,000 a month through organic methods first

principles.text: Coaching teaches you your market fast: recurring words and problems from calls become your offers, messaging and sales angles.
principles.quote: it's crazy how quickly you become expert in a market by actually coaching people cuz you start to spot the patterns
